verdict.rationale: First-party docs show each API reference page embeds a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec (e.g., specs/2026-09/account-account-info-v2026-09.json) and an agent-readable index at /docs/llms.txt, confirming a real OpenAPI-based spec exists per endpoint. However, independent probes for a single top-level downloadable spec (openapi.json, swagger.json, llms.txt at root) all returned 404, suggesting there is no one-shot full-API spec download — only per-endpoint fragments discoverable via docs navigation. Missing for 10: a consolidated single-file OpenAPI document confirmed downloadable, and independent/community verification of successfully fetching it.
